practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Making truth easier to live with
practice.issueStatement: Truth remains fragile when it is only admired. The deeper need is a life where honesty becomes normal enough that compromise stops feeling efficient.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani turns truth into practice through clean speech, aligned conduct, and repeated refusal of crooked gain. Honesty becomes durable when it is rehearsed in ordinary life.
practice.practicalReflection: The truthful life is usually plainer than the impressive one. But it is that plainer life that lets the heart stop splitting itself in two.
practice.actionPrompt: Pick one recurring place where you tend to bend the truth and practice a straighter way there until it begins to feel normal.
